subject.title: fix(whatsapp): add listGroupsLive for real-time group directory

question: Should WhatsApp live directory lookup be routed through a new gateway-owned runtime/RPC seam, or should the standalone live path be deferred until such a seam exists?
rationale: The current implementation fixes standalone discovery by violating the gateway's connection-ownership boundary; choosing the permanent cross-process query seam requires WhatsApp runtime-owner judgment.

options.title: Use the gateway-owned socket
options.body: Add a bounded gateway/runtime query path so the CLI requests group metadata from the existing connection and never opens the same persisted session twice.

options.title: Defer standalone live discovery
options.body: Remove the temporary socket path, keep controller-backed live lookup plus config fallback, and track the cross-process lookup separately.

recommendation.title: Use the gateway-owned socket
recommendation.body: Add a bounded gateway/runtime query path so the CLI requests group metadata from the existing connection and never opens the same persisted session twice.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the WhatsApp controller and socket lifecycle most closely associated with their recent merged work.
